notes: THE CAD TEXT-LAYER ANCHOR (see memory: cad-text-quirks). 26-sheet vector civil set for the same Taylor TX townhouse project (Paradise Engineers). Two traps: (1) plan sheets export their text 2-3x STACKED at identical coordinates (~950 of 1,548 words on the water plan are same-position dupes) — the pipeline's position-dedup must remove them or every summed quantity inflates ~3x; (2) every run and structure appears on the PLAN sheet AND again on its PROFILE sheet (sheet 13 drainage plan vs 14/16/19 profiles; 15 water plan; 18 WW plan) — merge by station label, never add plan + profile. There is NO summary-of-quantities table: totals come only from summing run callouts with that dedup. The authoritative storm source is the DRAINAGE PLAN (sheet 13: trunk + all lot laterals + curb inlets), not the storm profile (trunk only). Erosion control has no plan sheet (ESC details only) so it legitimately extracts as qualitative items with null quantity and is not scored here. Pipe LF anchors were callout-sum verified on 2026-06-22/07-22; structure counts are ±1-2. A got/want near 2 or 3 on a pipe line is the plan+profile or stacked-text failure — reported as scale_errors.
